  MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION  
  MANIPAL INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY - BENGALURU  
  SEVENTH SEMESTER B.TECH. DEGREE EXAMINATIONS - NOVEMBER 2025  
  Industrial Nanotechnology [PHY_4344]  
  Marks: 50                                                                               Duration: 180 mins.  
  PART-A  
  Answer all the questions.  
  1)            Compare the optical and electronic properties of bulk semiconductors with those of their  
  nanostructured counterparts.  
  (3)  
  A)  
  B)       Differentiate the top-down and bottom-up approaches used in the synthesis of  
  nanomaterials with examples.                                                               (3)  
  
  C)       Discover the role of BioMEMS in personalized medicine and health monitoring.               (4)  
  2)            Identify the mechanism of action of photosensitizers in photodynamic therapy.  
  (3)  
  A)  
  B)       Find the concept of targeted drug delivery and its relevance in modern therapy.            (3)  
  C)       Discover the four main objectives and advantages of controlled drug delivery.              (4)  
  3)            Quantum dots are generally found to be more advantageous when compared to  
  conventional fluorophores. Justify the statement with suitable reasons.  
  (3)  
  A)  
  B)       Assess how zeolites can be applied for wastewater treatment. What specific properties  
  make them suitable for removing heavy metal ions.                                          (3)  
  
  C)       Analyze why nanocatalysts exhibit higher catalytic activity compared to their bulk  
  counterparts. Give examples from industrial or environmental applications.                 (4)  
  
  4)            Identify how precision irrigation systems contribute to sustainable water use in  
  agriculture.  
  (3)  
  A)  
  B)       Assess how smart delivery systems can be used to supply nutrients to plants in a  
  controlled and sustained manner.                                                           (3)

  or odour-resistant fabrics.                                                              (4)
